dedupe_keys.name: multi period planning in metro aggregation networks exploiting point to multipoint coherent transceivers

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The integer-linear model plans a filterless metro network across several periods. It represents traffic predictability, transceiver availability and operating expenditure while minimising equipment cost. A deployed reference topology is used to report 20–32% transceiver-cost savings compared with P2P over five years; lower OpEx can require higher transceiver cost. Coverage is the published planning study and its companion conference paper, not a forecast valid for all operators. Exact input files and solver settings are unknown. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
